today i looked for things to use up around the kitchen.

cut up some onion (maybe 1/4 small yellow) and a bit of tomato, because it was in the fridge.

shredded perhaps 1cup shredded, noncompressed cheddar cheese

oiled the bottom and sides of a baking dish with olive oil
